question: What twofold movement is possible within the supreme itself?
premises: The supreme can relate to what is of the same kind.
This relation takes a twofold course.
One aspect of that twofold supreme can serve the arising of bliss.
inference: Even within the supreme there is a twofold movement, one aspect of which gives rise to bliss.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically incomplete and continues into the next verse.
